procedural_matters: The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
The Race Committee was represented by Christina Buch (CRO)
Timo Laukhardt (RO onboard the pin-end vessel) attended the hearing as a witness for the Race Committee.
Video evidence was presented during the hearing by the witnesss.
CHN 211985 did not come to the hearing, the hearing proceeded in accordance with RRS 63.1(b).
facts: Two seconds after the starting signal of Race Q5, CHN 211985 made repeated contacts with the starboard side bow quarter of the pin-end vessel.
It took CHN 211985 18 seconds to get clear from the pin-end vessel by taking to port
After tacking to port and getting clear from the pin-end vessel, CHN 211985 continued sailing on port tack for more than 30 seconds.
CHN 211985 did not take a penalty turn and finished the race.
conclusions: CHN 211985 touched the pin en vessel and broke RRS 31.

By knowingly breaking rule 31 and not taking the appropriate penalty, CHN 211985 failed to compete in compliance with the principles of sportsmanship and fair play as stated in RRS Basic Principles. CHN 211985 broke RRS 2.
decision: CHN 211985 is to be scored DNE in race Q5.
